admission.qualification: Actual Ruckig reference peak; wrapper corrects metadata only.

config.delay_scope: Upper torque transport only, from initialization; current state feedback, wheels and fingers undelayed; FIFO warm-start at first command.

state_stop_reference.geometry_type: Conservative local-geom AABBs of all collision-enabled upper-body and payload geoms, projected to world +x.
state_stop_reference.reference_parameter_role: Trajectory shaping settings, not calibrated payload damage or hardware limits.
state_stop_reference.corridor_role: Validity domain of this checked local IK interpolation; leaving it requires kinematic preparation, not a global infeasibility conclusion.
state_stop_reference.qualification: One-shot OTG plus sampled local corridor checks, not full MPC, global reachability or certified collision safety.

base_object_allocation.qualification: Shape parameters, not hardware maxima. Zero nominal upper stroke retains the same measured-base tracking corrections. No joint optimality or environmental collision certificate.

motion_distribution_audit.method: shared-object Jacobian local QP, offline path, degree-7 interpolation
motion_distribution_audit.objective: Task pose residual plus 1e-5 times joint-increment norm normalized by model joint-speed caps; same weights for both groups.
motion_distribution_audit.physical_speed_check: Performed on the timed stop reference and actual execution, not inferred from IK iteration steps.
motion_distribution_audit.collision_method: Nonlinear FK at accepted IK steps and independent interpolation grid; no continuous collision certificate or global route search.

config.arm_reference_note: Measured base forward displacement/velocity mapping from initialization; current command acceleration feedforward. One-dimensional straight-motion compensation, not full SE3 task control.
config.allocator_note: 5D internal wrench QP with normalized torque, handle-center moment proxy and regularization; conservative force diamond, not a complete contact wrench cone; no force feedback.
config.state_feedback_note: Ideal MuJoCo object COM/orientation/angular velocity for wrench/pose options; not a verified sensor pipeline.

legacy_cubic_admission_metadata.qualification: Reference acceleration envelope only; actual physical tracking requires validation.

regression.grasp_criterion_role: Legacy 2mm/2deg and tail diagnostics only; not a universal payload damage or retention guarantee.

reference_admission.geometry_type: Conservative local-geom AABBs of all collision-enabled upper-body and payload geoms, projected to world +x.
reference_admission.reference_parameter_role: Trajectory shaping settings, not calibrated payload damage or hardware limits.
reference_admission.corridor_role: Validity domain of this checked local IK interpolation; leaving it requires kinematic preparation, not a global infeasibility conclusion.
reference_admission.qualification: One-shot OTG plus sampled local corridor checks, not full MPC, global reachability or certified collision safety.

base_object_allocation.qualification: Shape parameters, not hardware maxima. Zero nominal upper stroke retains the same measured-base tracking corrections. No joint optimality or environmental collision certificate.

reference_admission.handover_note: Command seed continues the scheduled old reference at result release; measured state remains available to existing low-level feedback. Measured seed is retained as the stage-14 comparison. No physical state reset or future physical-state access.
reference_admission.delay_note: Deterministic simulated result-availability delay; candidate is predicted from known reference at trigger, then withheld until release. CPU wall time and simulator time are separate.

regression.qualification: Rigid payload in uncalibrated nominal physics with explicitly recorded controller assumptions; no hardware claim. Model states written only for initialization and separate kinematic references.

grasp_observation.wrench_convention: Contact contribution of object on hand, about each EE site, expressed in that hand frame; [Fx,Fy,Fz,Mx,My,Mz]. Not a wrist sensor including gripper dynamics.
grasp_observation.sliding_convention: Object-minus-pad point velocity in the contact tangent plane; normal-force-weighted speed per fixed pad geometry. Right-endpoint integral is tangential travel proxy, not net pose slip or a tracked material point.
grasp_observation.inactive_contact_policy: Undefined speed/friction entries are NaN; travel excludes unloaded intervals, separately observable in force/count arrays.
grasp_observation.force_epsilon_role: Masks near-zero denominators and labels recorded loaded contacts, not a physical grasp-success threshold.
grasp_observation.generalized_force_units: Nm for revolute joints, N for prismatic fingers; actual qfrc_actuator, not velocity command.
grasp_observation.qualification: Read-only live telemetry; no model or controller changes.
